gloss: offense and defense, attack and defense

definitions.gloss: offense and defense, attack and defense
definitions.explanation: The back-and-forth between attacking and defending. Used in military contexts, sports, debates, and competitive situations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{攻防|こうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: A fierce battle of offense and defense continued.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両|りょう}→両：11182_ryou⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻防|こうぼう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見応|みごた}え→見応え：07274_migotae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The back-and-forth between the two teams was exciting to watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{与野党|よやとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{攻防|こうぼう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{連日|れんじつ}→連日：14328_renjitsu⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The daily clash between the ruling and opposition parties in parliament is being reported on.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {攻|こう} (offense) and ⟦{防|ぼう}→防〜：03967_bou⟧ (defense). Frequently used in sports commentary to describe an exciting exchange between competing sides. Also common in political and military reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {攻防|こうぼう}⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: battle, offensive-defensive engagement
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{攻防|こうぼう}: fierce exchange of offense and defense
- {攻防|こうぼう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{広|ひろ}げる→繰り広げる：06982_kurihirogeru⟧: to wage a battle of offense and defense

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with ⟦{工房|こうぼう}→工房：12418_koubou⟧ (workshop, studio) or ⟦{興亡|こうぼう}→興亡：05568_koubou⟧ (rise and fall), which share the same reading.
